mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id, r.batch_id, r.status, r.quota_released, r.create_time, r.update_time, e.name AS equipment_name, l.name AS laboratory_name, b.start_time, b.end_time, b.booking_start_time, b.booking_end_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_reservation r LEFT JOIN tb_reservation_batch b ON r.batch_id = b.id LEFT JOIN tb_equipment e ON b.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN tb_laboratory l ON e.laboratory_id = l.id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.batch_id, r.status, r.quota_released, r.create_time, r.update_time FROM tb_reservation r WHERE r.status = 'CANCELLED' AND r.quota_released = 0 ORDER BY r.update_time ASC, r.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_reservation SET status = 'NO_SHOW' WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT r.id FROM tb_reservation r JOIN tb_reservation_batch b ON r.batch_id = b.id WHERE r.status = 'RESERVED' AND b.end_time < #{now} AND b.status <> 'CANCELLED' LIMIT #{limit} ) eligible )
